whyItMatters: A name or scope that resolves outside the project's intended registry is fetched from a source nobody reviewed, so a publish there becomes an install here. This rule reads an extra that installs development or test dependencies at runtime.
actions: Point the declaration or the registry configuration at the namespace the project controls, and remove the lookup path that resolves elsewhere. Specifically: fix an extra that installs development or test dependencies at runtime.
verification: Re-run the dependency scan and confirm requirements.txt no longer carries an extra that installs development or test dependencies at runtime.
